# SpeakMalayalam

> SpeakMalayalam (speakmalayalam.com) teaches everyday spoken Malayalam (the colloquial Malayalam used at home in Kerala) to native English speakers, partners and spouses of Malayalis, and the Malayali diaspora worldwide. Lessons come in Malayalam script, RRN Manglish romanisation and English, with audio. Founder and teacher: Reshmi R Nair (രശ്മി ആർ നായർ), an applied linguist actively pursuing linguistics, who has taught native English speakers and the Malayali diaspora worldwide for 15+ years (3,000+ students across 10+ countries) and has written in Malayala Manorama and Mathrubhumi.

Canonical site: https://speakmalayalam.com/
Sitemap: https://speakmalayalam.com/sitemap.xml
About the teacher: https://speakmalayalam.com/about.html
